After the merge, deploy-preview succeeds (gh run list and gh run watch); the owner runs the --secrets and --first-owner phases and dispatches a reseed

Read-only checks against the preview URL pass: /api/v1/health ok, /api/v1/session/me without a cookie returns 401 or 403, a deep link such as /tasks returns the app HTML, the security headers are present, the dev sign-in route returns 404

docs/backend/GO_LIVE.md tracks spec 21.11 (restore drill, access test as Ben, OAuth in production, empty live organization, weekly export, push on a phone, privacy notice, usage dashboard) with done or owner-pending for each
Final report lists the owner's remaining steps to release production
units.notes: Production stays empty and undeployed until the owner releases it after the client accepts the MVP (ADR-0002 section 5).

units.title: Real sign-in on deployed builds: Google button, session gating, sign-out
acceptance: With VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api, "Continue with Google" posts to /api/auth/sign-in/social (provider google, callback to the app) and navigates to the URL the server returns; a failure shows an inline error with Retry. Mock mode keeps today's persona behaviour.

The mock-only block (persona buttons, "Simulate unauthorized Google account") and every other dev-only control or wording (dev menu, sample-data banner, "simulated network latency" in error states) never render in an API build.

In API mode a 401 UNAUTHENTICATED from any request sends the person to /sign-in and back to the page they wanted after signing in; 403 ACCESS_PENDING goes to /access-pending; nothing renders sample or cached data while signed out; ox-mock-persona in localStorage is ignored.
Sign-out calls the server sign-out under /api/auth before clearing local state and returning to /sign-in.

A Playwright test in API mode stubs the Google round trip with route interception (no network to Google) and proves: button, then the sign-in/social request, then navigation to the returned URL; a signed-out visit to /tasks lands on /sign-in; sign-out ends the server session.

After the merge and a green deploy-preview, one read-only check: POST https://ordinovix-preview.ordinovix.workers.dev/api/auth/sign-in/social with header Origin: https://ordinovix-preview.ordinovix.workers.dev and body {"provider":"google","callbackURL":"/"} returns an accounts.google.com URL with a non-empty client_id and redirect_uri https://ordinovix-preview.ordinovix.workers.dev/api/auth/callback/google. If client_id is empty or the call fails for lack of secrets, record in QUEUE.md that the owner has not run --secrets yet, and continue.
units.notes: Added by the owner (2026-10-29): the deployed preview could not sign anyone in. Sign-in called the mock persona switch; nothing routed a 401 or 403 ACCESS_PENDING to /sign-in or /access-pending; the acceptance suite missed it because API mode signs in through the dev route. U32 stays blocked until the owner confirms a Google sign-in on the preview showing the Demo organization with data.

units.title: API mode is dependable: dev bootstrap, /audit accessibility, verify-api green
acceptance: On a fresh local database the dev bootstrap works: the Demo organization is seeded (or reset) before the dev sign-in, so `npm run dev` with VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api signs in without a manual seed; a test starts from an empty local D1
A failed dev sign-in is reported (console error and a visible dev-only notice) instead of being swallowed by an empty catch

Every U18 axe check passes in API mode in both themes, including while pages load (seen in CI: /audit aria-prohibited-attr on .space-y-4 in both themes; /clients dark color-contrast on the label of a transparent filter button)
The request dropped right after POST /api/v1/dev/reset (U30 note) is root-caused and fixed, or the reset answers only when the Worker is ready; the 500 ms client wait is removed if no longer needed

The verify-api acceptance step reports zero failures (check its annotations and log, since continue-on-error keeps the job green) on this PR and on the next merge to main; then write to QUEUE.md the owner edit that removes `continue-on-error: true` from that step in .github/workflows/verify.yml
units.notes: Found by the owner-side check of PR #37 (2026-10-28): CI's fresh local D1 left every data-dependent API-mode test signed out; with a seeded database 158 of 160 passed locally, the two failures being /audit axe in both themes; CI with the seed step failed 3 of 160: those two plus /clients dark color-contrast. The CI job now seeds before the run; the bootstrap must not depend on that.

units.title: Phone reminders: Turn on reminders subscribes the device; the service worker shows pushes
acceptance: 'Turn on reminders' (Welcome wizard and Settings, Notifications) asks for permission only after the tap (spec 19.3 Push), then subscribes with the key from GET /api/v1/push/vapid-key and saves the subscription; it shows On and offers Turn off, which removes the subscription
iPhone without the app on the Home Screen, or an unsupported browser: the button explains what is needed (iOS 16.4 or later, Add to Home Screen) instead of failing

The service worker shows a pushed notification with the lock-screen-safe text (client and task codes only, spec 14) and opens its link on click, focusing an open window when there is one; keep vite-plugin-pwa generateSW and add the handler through workbox.importScripts (no new package)
Sign-out removes this device's push subscription (spec 19.5)
Mock mode keeps the 'Push preview' toast (spec 14); tests stub Notification and PushManager; no network in tests
units.notes: Spec sections 14 and 19.3 in Inspirations/Ordinovix_Build_Spec_v2.md. The Worker routes exist since U29.

units.title: Notifications created by actions (spec 14), in the Worker and the mock
acceptance: Write handlers create the event notifications of spec 14 with the spec's recipients and text: Received needs review (helper marks a line received or uploads; to the task owner, or the organization owner when helpers can't accept), Visit ready, Left without everything ready, Outcome recorded (by a helper), Assigned to you (task or visit)
Each notification links to a record that exists; duplicates collapse to one per type, record and day; the notification row is written in the same batch as the change
Pushes follow each type's push default and the person's settings, respect quiet hours, and use codes only (no names, TINs, amounts or document contents)
The mock creates the same notifications for the same actions, so both modes show the same Notifications screen; tests cover each type in both
units.notes: Found in the U29 review: only the cron notifications existed.

units.title: Reports with real numbers; opening a period returns the real line count
acceptance: reports.monthlySummary returns values computed from the data (shared function in src/domain, used by the mock and the Worker), matching what Today and Insights show for the same month
reports.exportCsv returns the real rows with masked TINs only (spec 19.5), a BOM for Excel, and the same columns as the screen
tasks.openPeriod returns the real number of tasks and lines it created, in both modes
Client history and client checklist reports read real data; a fixture-based test checks exact numbers for one month
units.notes: Found in the U27 review: monthlySummary and exportCsv were stubs.

units.title: Offline and install details from spec 19.3 and 19.5
acceptance: A failed offline write holds every later write until it is retried or discarded (owner decision, QUEUE.md Decided 2026-10-28); the queue shows the failed item with Retry and Discard
Creating clients and opening periods are disabled offline with a hint (spec 19.3)
Sign-out warns when the offline queue is not empty, then clears caches and the queue (spec 19.5)

An 'Install app' button outside the Welcome wizard uses beforeinstallprompt on Android and desktop, and iPhone gets the Share, Add to Home Screen instructions card; neither shows once the app is installed
The persisted query cache (spec 19.3 Offline data) needs a package that is not approved: write the proposal to QUEUE.md, do not install it
units.notes: Found in the U17 review.

units.title: Every edit sends its version; If-Match * refused outside local; TIN key recovery step
acceptance: Every caller of an update sends the record's version, including calendar drag and undo, the Welcome wizard's sequential settings saves, the helpers-can-accept toggle and settings.save; a test fails if an update route is called without one
The Worker honours If-Match: * only when the dev sign-in is enabled (local); in preview and production an update without a real version returns 422, and a stale one 409

setup-cloudflare.mjs gains --escrow for production: it generates TIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, shows it once with a prompt to store it in a password manager, requires typing the last 6 characters back, then sets it; it never logs or writes it; phase 2 for production refuses to generate the TIN key without --escrow; tests use the stubbed runner
DEPLOY.md 'Releasing production' includes the escrow step before any real client data
units.notes: Owner decisions (QUEUE.md Decided 2026-10-28): keep If-Match * until this unit; recovery copy via a password manager.
